display.title: Yud-Beis Tammuz: The Frierdiker Rebbe's Victory for All Jews
display.summary_short: The story of the Frierdiker Rebbe's arrest in 1927 for teaching Torah and his miraculous release on the 12th of Tammuz, and why it matters to every child in Tzivos Hashem.
display.summary_long: A Yud-Beis Tammuz talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that in 1927 the Frierdiker Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneerson, was imprisoned in Russia for teaching Torah and mitzvos, especially to young children, which the government had forbidden. He had continued at the risk of his life to set an example. Jews all over the world prayed, and through a miracle he was freed on the 12th of Tammuz, his birthday. Communities everywhere celebrate the day with thanks to Hashem, because his victory was a victory for all of Klal Yisroel: he went straight back to building yeshivos, shuls and mikvaos, and today there are yeshivos throughout the world thanks to his mesiras nefesh. Tzivos Hashem itself exists in his merit, since the Jewish child was always at the top of his list. Children are asked to make strong resolutions for Yud-Beis Tammuz and to pray that this Geulah leads to the final Geulah.
display.lesson: The Frierdiker Rebbe risked his life so that children could learn Torah; we honor him by learning more Torah and doing more mitzvos.
